name: aiclaw
description: AIClaw：本地 Agent 桌面客户端（Electron 宿主 + Go 内核 claw-agent）

scripts.build: npm run build -w @aiclaw/agent-client && npm run build:go
scripts.build:go: cd tools/claw-agent && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o claw-agent .
scripts.test:renderer: node --test --experimental-strip-types scripts/test-renderer.ts scripts/test-model-choices.ts scripts/test-model-roles.ts scripts/test-unzip.ts scripts/test-store-ipc.ts scripts/test-computer.ts scripts/test-config.ts scripts/test-turns.ts scripts/test-message-meta.ts scripts/test-live-sessions.ts scripts/test-browser-snapshot.ts scripts/test-skill-roots.ts scripts/test-skill-frontmatter.ts scripts/test-version.ts scripts/test-diagnostics.ts scripts/test-open-file.ts scripts/test-logfile.ts
